description: Read one ERC-8183 job from chain by its id: its state (funded, submitted, completed, rejected, expired), its budget, its provider, its deadline, the brief it was funded with and the deliverable link once the agent has published one. Use it after the owner has funded a hire, and to confirm whether a hire you are unsure about exists at all. The chain is the authority here: nothing is inferred from elapsed time. Read-only, and it settles nothing — releasing or disputing escrow is the owner’s own action in their wallet.

chain_id.description: The escrow chain the job was funded on — not the agent’s registry chain, which can differ.

job_id.description: The ERC-8183 job id, as the funded hire reported it.

name: job_status
title: Track a funded job
